name: Tech Bubble Burst
description: Technology valuations reach absurd levels in an IPO frenzy before reality catches up, triggering a sector-wide reckoning

phases.name: Euphoria Peak
headlines: Unprofitable {sector} startup IPOs at $50B valuation on first-day pop
{sector} valuations hit dot-com era multiples as retail investors pile in
Every new {sector} IPO doubles on day one — analysts warn of irrational exuberance
phases.summary: Technology valuations reach absurd levels as a wave of unprofitable companies IPO to enormous first-day gains. Retail investor mania drives {sector} stocks to historic price-to-sales ratios.

phases.name: First Cracks
headlines: Flagship {sector} company misses revenue estimates by 40%, stock crashes after hours
Sector rotation accelerates as institutions dump {sector} for value plays
{sector} IPO market freezes overnight after string of broken deals
phases.summary: A major {sector} bellwether reports catastrophically weak earnings, shattering the growth narrative. Institutional investors begin aggressive rotation out of the sector as IPO markets slam shut.

phases.name: Orderly Deflation
headlines: {sector} repricing continues but quality names find buyers at lower levels
Value investors selectively accumulating profitable {sector} companies
{sector} correction orderly so far — no margin call cascades reported
phases.summary: The {sector} sector undergoes a painful but orderly repricing. Profitable companies with real earnings stabilize at lower valuations while speculative names continue falling.

phases.name: Panic Crash
headlines: Margin calls trigger forced liquidation across {sector} — circuit breakers hit
{sector} index plunges 15% in single session as panic selling overwhelms buyers
Even blue-chip {sector} stocks crushed as indiscriminate selling takes hold
phases.summary: Orderly selling gives way to outright panic as margin calls cascade through the {sector} sector. Even fundamentally strong companies are crushed in the rush for the exits.

phases.name: Selective Recovery
headlines: Profitable {sector} leaders begin recovery as valuations reach attractive levels
Bargain hunters drive selective {sector} rally — quality over hype
{sector} sector bifurcation: profitable firms recover while speculative names languish
phases.summary: Value emerges in quality {sector} names as the market begins differentiating between profitable leaders and speculative plays. A selective recovery takes shape.

phases.name: Tech Winter
headlines: {sector} enters prolonged winter — venture funding collapses 80% from peak
Mass layoffs sweep {sector} sector as companies fight for survival
Analysts warn {sector} underperformance could last years as trust destroyed
phases.summary: The crash ushers in a prolonged tech winter. Venture funding evaporates, mass layoffs sweep the sector, and investors shun {sector} stocks for years to come.

phases.name: New Equilibrium
headlines: {sector} sector stabilizes at sustainable valuations after painful correction
Lessons learned: {sector} investors demand profitability over growth at any cost
phases.summary: The {sector} sector finds a new equilibrium at more sustainable valuations. Investor discipline returns with a focus on profitability over growth-at-any-cost narratives.

phases.name: Structural Reset
headlines: {sector} sector fundamentally reshaped — only strongest survivors remain
Post-crash {sector} landscape: fewer companies, lower multiples, chastened investors
phases.summary: The {sector} sector undergoes a structural reset. Most speculative companies have failed or been acquired, leaving a smaller but more fundamentally sound industry.

name: AI Revolution
description: A breakthrough in artificial intelligence capabilities triggers a massive investment rush with the potential to be either a real paradigm shift or the next great bubble

phases.name: Breakthrough Announced
headlines: Major {sector} company unveils AI system that passes every professional benchmark
AI breakthrough sparks frenzy — {sector} stocks surge on 'new era' narrative
Experts call latest AI advancement a 'once in a generation' technology shift
phases.summary: A breakthrough AI system demonstrates capabilities previously thought years away. The announcement triggers a surge in {sector} stocks as investors scramble for exposure to the AI revolution.

phases.name: Investment Mania
headlines: AI-related {sector} stocks triple in months as FOMO grips markets
Every company adding 'AI' to their name sees instant valuation boost
Record capital flows into {sector} AI funds — $100B in single quarter
phases.summary: An unprecedented investment mania takes hold as AI-related {sector} stocks surge 200-300%. Companies rush to rebrand as AI plays and capital floods into anything AI-adjacent.

phases.name: Earnings Validate Hype
headlines: AI leaders report explosive revenue growth — earnings finally catching up to valuations
{sector} AI adoption accelerates: 60% of Fortune 500 now deploying AI systems
AI productivity gains show up in GDP data for first time
phases.summary: In a rare validation of market enthusiasm, AI companies begin delivering massive revenue growth. Enterprise adoption accelerates and productivity gains start appearing in economic data.

phases.name: Reality Check
headlines: Major AI project fails spectacularly — {sector} company writes off $20B investment
Enterprise AI adoption stalls as companies struggle to find profitable use cases
AI bubble comparison intensifies as {sector} revenue growth disappoints
phases.summary: A spectacular AI project failure exposes the gap between hype and reality. Enterprise adoption stalls as companies struggle to monetize AI, drawing inevitable bubble comparisons.

phases.name: Paradigm Shift Confirmed
headlines: AI transforms {sector} economics — new business models emerge at unprecedented pace
{sector} AI leaders now among most profitable companies in history
Economists raise long-term growth forecasts citing AI-driven productivity revolution
phases.summary: The AI revolution proves real as new business models and unprecedented productivity gains reshape the {sector} landscape. AI leaders become among the most profitable companies ever.

phases.name: AI Bubble Bursts
headlines: AI {sector} stocks crash 60% from peak as bubble fully deflates
AI startups shuttering at record pace — funding market frozen
{sector} AI winter sets in as investors flee the narrative
phases.summary: The AI bubble fully deflates as {sector} stocks crash from their highs. AI startup funding freezes and the sector enters a prolonged period of investor skepticism.

phases.name: New Tech Landscape
headlines: AI-powered {sector} companies dominate market — new equilibrium established
Post-revolution {sector} landscape favors AI-native companies over legacy players
phases.summary: A new {sector} landscape emerges dominated by AI-native companies. Legacy firms that failed to adapt have been left behind as the paradigm shift reaches maturity.

phases.name: Slow Rehabilitation
headlines: AI technology quietly matures away from spotlight as {sector} valuations normalize
Surviving {sector} AI firms begin modest recovery — hype gone, substance remains
phases.summary: Away from the spotlight, AI technology continues maturing quietly. Surviving {sector} companies with genuine AI capabilities begin a slow rehabilitation as valuations normalize.

name: Corporate Mega-Fraud
description: A whistleblower exposes massive accounting fraud at a major company, potentially revealing systemic issues across the industry

phases.name: Whistleblower Bombshell
headlines: Whistleblower alleges {company} fabricated years of revenue data
SEC launches emergency investigation into {company} accounting practices
{company} shares plunge 30% on fraud allegations — trading halted
phases.summary: A former executive turned whistleblower presents evidence that {company} has been systematically fabricating revenue figures for years. The SEC opens an emergency investigation as the stock crashes.

phases.name: Auditor Confirms
headlines: Independent auditor confirms material irregularities in {company} financial statements
{company} stock halted indefinitely as board fires CEO and CFO
DOJ opens criminal investigation into {company} executives
phases.summary: An independent audit confirms massive accounting irregularities at {company}. The board fires senior leadership, the stock is halted indefinitely, and the DOJ opens criminal proceedings.

phases.name: Contained Scandal
headlines: Investigation finds {company} fraud was isolated — no industry-wide issues
{sector} peers rally as contagion fears fade after targeted audits
{company} stock resumes trading at fraction of former value under new management
phases.summary: Extensive investigation determines the fraud was isolated to {company}. Industry-wide audits clear other firms, and {company} resumes trading under new management at a fraction of its former value.

phases.name: Systemic Contagion
headlines: Second major {sector} company reveals accounting restatement — contagion spreads
Investors question every {sector} company's books — sell first, ask questions later
Auditing firms under fire as {sector} accounting scandal widens
phases.summary: The scandal proves systemic as a second {sector} company reveals accounting irregularities. Investors lose trust in the entire sector's financial reporting, triggering indiscriminate selling.

phases.name: Company Restructures
headlines: {company} CEO sentenced to 20 years — investors seek closure
{company} restructuring plan wins creditor approval — long road to recovery
{sector} sector fully recovered from isolated fraud incident
phases.summary: {company} executives face criminal sentences while the company restructures under new leadership. The broader {sector} sector has fully recovered from the isolated incident.

phases.name: Industry-Wide Reckoning
headlines: Congress passes emergency corporate transparency act after {sector} scandal
{sector} stocks hit multi-year lows as regulatory overhaul takes shape
Multiple {sector} executives face criminal charges in widening fraud probe
phases.summary: The widening scandal triggers sweeping regulatory reform. Multiple {sector} executives face criminal charges as Congress passes emergency corporate transparency legislation.

phases.name: Justice Served
headlines: {company} emerges from restructuring as smaller but credible entity
Post-fraud reforms strengthen investor confidence across {sector}
phases.summary: {company} emerges from restructuring as a smaller but credible company. Post-fraud reforms have actually strengthened investor confidence in {sector} financial reporting.

phases.name: Trust Rebuilt Slowly
headlines: {sector} slowly regains investor trust under strict new compliance regime
Post-scandal {sector} landscape: higher compliance costs but restored credibility
phases.summary: The {sector} slowly rebuilds investor trust under a strict new compliance regime. Higher compliance costs become permanent but credibility gradually returns.

name: Regulatory Earthquake
description: Government announces sweeping new regulations that threaten to fundamentally reshape an entire industry

phases.name: Regulatory Bombshell
headlines: Government unveils sweeping {sector} regulations that could reshape entire industry
{sector} stocks plunge as leaked regulatory framework exceeds worst expectations
Industry leaders call proposed {sector} rules 'existential threat to business models'
phases.summary: The government announces comprehensive new regulations targeting the {sector} industry that go far beyond market expectations. Industry leaders warn the rules could fundamentally break existing business models.

phases.name: Lobbying Battle
headlines: {sector} industry spends record $2B on lobbying campaign against new rules
Public opinion firmly supports {sector} regulation — lobbying campaign backfires
Final regulatory vote on {sector} rules approaches amid intense political battle
phases.summary: The {sector} industry mounts the most expensive lobbying campaign in history but public opinion strongly favors regulation. The political battle intensifies as the final vote approaches.

phases.name: Industry Adapts
headlines: {sector} companies find creative compliance strategies — impact less severe than feared
Leading {sector} firms pivot business models successfully under new framework
New regulations create competitive moat for large {sector} players
phases.summary: {sector} companies prove more adaptable than expected, finding creative compliance strategies. Large incumbents actually benefit as regulatory complexity creates barriers to entry.

phases.name: Business Models Broken
headlines: Multiple {sector} companies announce they cannot operate profitably under new rules
{sector} mass layoffs begin as companies slash operations to comply
Investment banks downgrade entire {sector} sector to 'underweight'
phases.summary: The regulations prove fatal to existing {sector} business models. Companies announce they cannot operate profitably, triggering mass layoffs and sector-wide downgrades.

phases.name: New Competitive Landscape
headlines: {sector} sector stabilizes under new regulatory regime — winners emerge
Adapted {sector} companies report surprisingly strong margins post-regulation
Regulatory clarity actually boosting long-term {sector} investment
phases.summary: A new competitive landscape emerges in {sector} as adapted companies report strong margins. Regulatory clarity actually encourages long-term investment as uncertainty lifts.

phases.name: Sector Collapse
headlines: {sector} companies flee jurisdiction — industry hollowed out by regulation
First major {sector} bankruptcy filed citing regulatory compliance costs
{sector} employment drops 40% from pre-regulation levels
phases.summary: The {sector} sector undergoes a dramatic collapse as companies either flee the jurisdiction or go bankrupt under the weight of compliance costs. Employment in the sector drops precipitously.

phases.name: Regulated Prosperity
headlines: {sector} sector thriving under new rules — regulation becomes competitive advantage
International firms cite strong {sector} regulatory framework as reason to invest
phases.summary: The {sector} sector enters a period of regulated prosperity. The clear regulatory framework becomes a competitive advantage attracting international investment.

phases.name: Regulatory Rollback Begins
headlines: Political pressure mounts to roll back {sector} regulations after economic damage
Partial {sector} regulatory relief announced — too little too late for many firms
phases.summary: The economic damage from {sector} regulation triggers political pressure for rollbacks. Partial relief is announced but comes too late for many firms that have already exited or failed.
